reviews.title: Best study job ever!!!
reviews.review: I have been using this app since 2018. It have not let me down once. My science teacher required fifteen minutes a day on Quizlet and I never scored below 97% on a test. This app has helped me keep straight A in so many different ways. The first way is that it is a very easy app to navigate. This app keeps it very simple with only a few buttons. They also have a help button in their guide that can help you get unstuck if you are stuck. You need minimal tech knowledge to operate this app.

reviews.title: Amazing Website, but App is Not Necessary
reviews.review: Quizlet is such an amazing site, which helps me memorize a lot of information in a short amount of time. I definitely recommend turning on the track progress feature when you are doing flashcards, so you can focus on what you are struggling with.
